title: Video: The Challenge For Fixed Income Investors
text:
Video: The Challenge For Fixed Income Investors

Louis-Vincent Gave

Gavekal Research

| 17 Sep 2026

So far this decade, US treasuries have delivered no returns whilst European government bonds have delivered negative returns. Japanese government bonds have been an unmitigated disaster. The one major government bond market that did deliver positive returns has been China’s. This performance divergence is explained by many factors, but principally by the fact that while fiscal and monetary policies in the west have actively encouraged inflation, in China and most other emerging markets, inflation is still considered a genuine threat to social and economic stability. Still, following a dismal five years, is it time to return to OECD government bonds? Or to put it another way, which policy settings in the Western world might change and encourage savers to return to beaten-up bond markets? These are the issues Louis tackles in this video.
